name: fullscreen
title: Fullscreen
description: A button that toggles fullscreen mode for the whole page. It hides itself in browsers without the Fullscreen API.

attributes.name: data-fullscreen
attributes.description: Enables the behavior for the buttons inside it.

attributes.name: data-fullscreen-target="button"
attributes.description: Hidden when fullscreen is not supported. Start it hidden so it never flashes.
